offering_description.value: The company makes and supplies HVAC, plumbing and electrical equipment and installation products for contractors, primarily through wholesalers. It formulates lubricants and other maintenance chemicals for industrial operators. It also designs and fabricates fire protection products, railings and other building systems for commercial construction.

primary_products.value: HVAC equipment and installation accessories; plumbing and electrical supplies; industrial lubricants and specialty chemicals; fire and smoke protection systems; architectural railings and expansion joint covers

customer_segment.value: B2B: HVAC, plumbing and electrical wholesalers, industrial distributors, maintenance operators and commercial building contractors

end_markets.value: HVAC installation and repair; plumbing and electrical trades; mining; rail transportation; commercial construction

revenue_model.value: product sales: Equipment, installation supplies, industrial maintenance consumables and architectural building products; project or contract: Custom railing fabrication and installation for construction projects

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns components, chemicals and metals into finished products for trade wholesalers, industrial operators and construction contractors; distributor: Supplies sourced trade products to HVAC, plumbing and electrical wholesalers; service provider: Uses building plans and site specifications to design and install railings for commercial contractors

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with sales in Canada and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: Contractor equipment and supplies, industrial maintenance consumables, and engineered building systems

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: HVAC, plumbing and electrical wholesalers and industrial supply distributors; direct sales: Commercial contractors and industrial accounts; agents / brokers: Independent manufacturers’ representatives for architectural building products
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Chemical manufacturing and handling under EPA and OSHA rules, plus building and fire codes for architectural systems

notes: Recent portfolio changes and the full international sales footprint are uncertain.
divestiture_lines: P2.14: through a spin-off from CSWC, with operating companies that are long established names in their respective end markets.
